name: goodreads-reviews-to-notion

deploy.description: Readwise Books 'Book Finished' (Readwise (Unofficial) private app) -> create a 'Book Review' idea in the Notion Social Content data source (a finished book becomes a LinkedIn content idea). Originally the classic Zap 'Log Book Reviews in Notion' on a Goodreads RSS feed.

trigger.trigger_note: Readwise (Unofficial) 'Book Finished' — work.flowers' private CLI integration (source: github.com/work-flowers/zapier-readwise). A polling trigger on GET readwise.io/books/api/v1/books; dedupes on `<book id>-finished`, so each book fires once. Replaced the Goodreads read-shelf RSS trigger (RSSCLIAPI@1.1.0 new_feed) on 2026-11-23. Polls at the durable default (~1/min): one GET /books per poll against Readwise's 20/min limit, and polls cost no tasks.

dependencies_note: Bumped 2026-11-27 to durable 0.14.1 / SDK 0.115.1 (Zapier refuses publishes below SDK 0.107.0). First attempted in PR #332, whose publish run stopped at an earlier Zap before reaching this one; shipped by the follow-up PR.
